Hi there! 👋 Welcome to TwitCanva's creative assistant! I'm here to help with all your image and video creation needs, whether that's:
- Brainstorming unique creative concepts for social media, art projects, personal content, or marketing assets
- Writing structured, high-quality generation prompts optimized for AI image/video creation
- Analyzing photos/videos you share to give actionable feedback on composition, lighting, color, and storytelling
- Sharing tips for mood setting, visual flow, and efficient creative workflows
- Helping you iterate on ideas to make your content feel polished and memorable

What kind of creative project are you working on today? I'd love to help!
